eligibility: British citizens: the ETA covers tourism, Umrah, family visits and business
Other passports: business or family visit visa, or the tourist eVisa if eligible
Moving to Saudi Arabia: work visa or residence visa

faqs.q: Do British citizens need a visa for Saudi Arabia?
faqs.a: No, not for visits. Since July 2026 British citizens can apply for a Saudi ETA instead.

faqs.q: Can I do Umrah on the Saudi ETA?
faqs.a: Yes, outside the Hajj season. Hajj requires a dedicated Hajj visa.

faqs.q: What do I need for a Saudi work visa?
faqs.a: A work visa reference from your employer, a medical, an attested degree certificate and an attested ACRO police certificate. We arrange the medical and attestations.

sections.heading: Saudi ETA for British citizens
sections.text: Since 1 July 2026, British citizens can use the [Saudi ETA](/saudi-arabia-eta-uk/) for tourism, Umrah outside Hajj season, family visits and business, with multiple entries.

sections.heading: Business and family visit visas
sections.text: Other passport holders living in the UK can apply for a [Saudi business visa](/saudi-business-visa-uk/) or a [Saudi family visit visa](/saudi-family-visit-visa-uk/), usually processed in about 72 hours.

sections.heading: Working or living in Saudi Arabia
sections.text: A [Saudi work visa](/saudi-work-visa-uk/) or [Saudi residence visa](/saudi-residence-visa-uk/) needs a medical, a police certificate and FCO attestation. We arrange all of it, and each page has a calculator so you can see your total.

sections.heading: Saudi visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers, families and businesses across the UK with Saudi visas.
